description: Council baseline attestation for suimin (mirror of com.etzhayyim.mitate.silenMitateReview). Witness invariant N>=3 Council Lv6+ DIDs (+ optional licensed sleep-medicine MD). Gates removal of the import-time RuntimeError on suimin_* cells per scope. Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 3 G9 / §Decision 5/6.

scope.description: Which baseline this review ratifies. Each cell checks the scope(s) it depends on before lifting its gate.

witnessDids.description: N>=3 Council Lv6+ DIDs (G9). A licensed sleep-medicine MD DID may be added (R1 evidence-review / R2 in-loop, G8).

licensedSleepMdDid.description: Optional licensed sleep-medicine MD attesting the clinical baseline (G8).

attestationTxHash.description: Council Lv6+ >=3 multisig tx hash (becomes COUNCIL_CHARTER_ATTESTATION_TX_HASH for the gated cells).
